item.create_connection.speaker: Speaker
create_connection.ponder.phone_line.head: Telephone line
create_connection.ponder.phone_line.text: Phones are Power Grid devices with two terminals on the back
Wire the terminals to a source: phones on one line can call each other
At least 6 V is needed; above 250 V the phone burns out
Right-click picks up the handset. Click the display's top line to set your number (5 digits)
Dial 5 digits and the call goes out by itself. LShift hangs up
The receiving phone rings and shows the caller's number
A comparator next to a ringing phone outputs 15
create_connection.ponder.phone_bell.head: Bell and dyeing
create_connection.ponder.phone_bell.text: Without a bell the phone only chirps quietly
Right-click with a bell to fit a brass gong under the handset
Now the gong shakes and rings like an old telephone
Shift + right-click with an empty hand removes the bell
Any dye recolours the phone's body
create_connection.ponder.payphone.text_1: A payphone has no number of its own: it can only make calls
create_connection.ponder.payphone.text_2: A call costs a token, a Create copper nugget by default
create_connection.ponder.payphone.text_3: The person you call sees "Unknown number"
create_connection.ponder.service_phone.t: Place the phone right next to a villager's job site to bind that villager
Calling this phone's number opens trading with the villager
If the villager is asleep, busy or away, the caller sees "Subscriber unavailable"
Next to the blaze burner or seated mob of a stock ticker, the phone opens the stock order window
create_connection.ponder.radio_station.t: A radio station only transmits. Right-click to pick a frequency 00–15
It needs a Create Radars network controller with a radar attached
Right-click the controller with a data link, then the station: the link is placed on it
The station's range equals the network radar's range
On its frequency it transmits the redstone strength, nearby sounds and headset voices
On radar monitors radios are marked: receivers orange, transmitters brown
create_connection.ponder.radio.text_1: Right-click opens the radio: frequency 00–15 (turn the knob) and Transmit / Receive mode
create_connection.ponder.radio.text_2: A transmitting radio is on air while it receives redstone
create_connection.ponder.radio.text_3: A receiving radio on the same frequency outputs the same signal and plays the sound
create_connection.ponder.radio.text_4: Radios hear each other within 30 blocks and pick up a station on their frequency anywhere in its range
Shift + right-click the station's data link with a walkie-talkie to join its network
Right-click to start transmitting (the antenna tip glows red), again to stop
Without a station it uses open air within 30 blocks. Shift + right-click in the air to unlink
A headset links the same way. Wear it and your voice goes on air hands-free
create_connection.ponder.radio_audio.hea: Radio speaker, hand microphone and stand
create_connection.ponder.radio_audio.tex: Right-click a radio speaker with a hand microphone to link it. Several speakers can be linked
Hold right-click to raise the microphone to your mouth: your voice plays from the linked speakers
The stand simply holds the microphone: while it's there, voices and nearby sounds go to its speakers. Right-click with an empty hand to take it
The speaker plays only while powered
Right-click with a megaphone to fit a horn: the speaker carries 32 blocks farther. Shift + right-click to remove
Villagers, sculk sensors and wardens hear the speaker like the real sound: a bell over the radio calls villagers home
block.create_connection.home_phone.toolt: A rotary _wired telephone_ powered through a Power Grid network.
Wire the _terminals_ on the back to a _6–250 V_ source. You can call phones on the same line.
Pick up: dial on the rotary disk, click the top line to set _your 5-digit number_. _LShift_ hangs up.
A _bell_ gives an old-style ring, a _dye_ recolours the body.
block.create_connection.payphone.tooltip: A street payphone: _outgoing calls only_, paid with a token.
It has no number and can't be called. The callee sees _"Unknown number"_.
Each call costs a _token_ (a Create copper nugget by default).
block.create_connection.service_phone.to: A service phone: _trade with a villager_ or _order from storage_ by calling it.
Binds the villager; a call opens _trading_. If they can't answer — _"Subscriber unavailable"_.
Next to the blaze burner or seated mob of a _stock ticker_, a call opens the _order window_.
block.create_connection.radio_station.to: Connects to a Create Radars _network controller_ with a data link. Range equals the network _radar's range_.
Transmits _redstone strength_, nearby sounds and headset voices. Walkies and headsets link by Shift + right-clicking its data link.
block.create_connection.radio.tooltip.su: A radio with _transmit_ and _receive_ modes on frequency 00–15.
block.create_connection.radio.tooltip.be: Tuning window: turn the frequency knob and pick a mode.
On air while _powered_: sends its strength and nearby sounds.
Outputs the same _redstone_ and sound. Hears radios within _30 blocks_ and stations of its frequency in their range.
block.create_connection.radio_speaker.to: Plays _hand microphones_ and _microphone stands_ out loud.
Links the speaker to the microphone, again to unlink. Walkies, headsets and stations are not played.
Fits a _horn_: it carries 32 blocks farther. Villagers and sculk sensors react to its sound like the real thing.
block.create_connection.microphone_stand: A stand that simply holds a _hand microphone_.
Puts the microphone on the stand. _Right-click_ with an empty hand to take it.
Voices and sounds around the stand play from the _radio speakers_ linked to the microphone. No redstone needed.
item.create_connection.walkie_talkie.too: Toggle _transmitting_ — the antenna tip glows red.
Shift + right-click a station's data link
Join the _station network_. _Shift + right-click_ in the air to unlink (open air, 30 blocks).
item.create_connection.hand_microphone.t: Links the speaker to the microphone, again to unlink. Several can be linked. _Shift + right-click_ in the air unlinks all.
Raise it to your mouth: your voice and nearby sounds play from the _linked speakers_ (they must be powered by redstone).
item.create_connection.megaphone.tooltip: A _megaphone_: a loud voice and a horn for radio speakers.
Your voice (Simple Voice Chat) carries _16 blocks farther_ than usual.
Fits a _horn_: the speaker carries _32 blocks farther_ (56 instead of 24). Shift + right-click with an empty hand removes it.
item.create_connection.radio_headset.too: A _headset with microphone_ for a station network.
Shift + right-click a station's data link
Link to the station. _Shift + right-click_ in the air to unlink.
You hear the network and your _voice_ goes on air hands-free.
create_connection.msg.signaler_mode_on: Morse Transmission Mode: Hold RMB to transmit signal (LMB / Shift+RMB to exit)
create_connection.gui.morse_table.title: Morse Punch-Card Table
create_connection.gui.morse_table.status: Punch card on table — ready to play
block.create_connection.morse_signaler.t: A telegraph _Morse key_ for transmitting audio and radio signals.
block.create_connection.morse_table.tool: Punches short _Morse code_ messages onto _Paper_ to create _Punch Cards_ and plays them back.
item.create_connection.punch_card.toolti: Stores a _Morse code_ message that can be played on a _Morse Punch-Card Table_.
block.create_connection.morse_signaler.t: Enters _transmission mode_. Hold _Right-Click_ to key signals (short press for dot, long press for dash). _Left-Click_ or _Shift + Right-Click_ to exit.
Automatically broadcasts the _Morse_ signal over the air and outputs _redstone_ power 15.
A wearable backpack radio station with a _64-block_ range, combining the features of a Radio Station and a Walkie-Talkie.
Provides _64-block_ network coverage around the wearer and transmits/receives voice and radio signals.
Opens the frequency tuning panel (_00.0–15.0_). R-Clicking with a Walkie-Talkie or Headset links it to this station.
create_connection.tooltip.portable_stati: R-Click in inventory to tune frequency
